description: Test suite for permissions management commands in Mattermost, including adding, removing, and resetting role permissions.

methods.name: TestAddPermissionsCmd
methods.description: Unit test for adding permissions to roles, including success and failure scenarios.

methods.name: TestRemovePermissionsCmd
methods.description: Unit test for removing permissions from roles, including multiple and non-existing permissions and roles.

methods.name: TestResetPermissionsCmd
methods.description: Unit test for resetting role permissions to default, including non-existent roles and roles without default permissions.
